verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Asana publishes an llms.txt at developers.asana.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that indexes its developer documentation. Its docs are also served as markdown (.md) pages, such as the webhooks guide and MCP docs, so an agent can be pointed straight at them. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content variant, and no independent or community corroboration of how well agents consume these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://developers.asana.com/llms.txt # Asana Docs Documentation
